claims.title: Deterministic experiment subsets induce an exact refinement lattice of fixed-model observation cells
claims.scope: finite globally fixed model families with deterministic finite-valued model-label experiments
assumptions: experiment subset S reveals the joint labels of experiments in S
one fixed model generates the observation signature
all experiment label vectors are predeclared
nonclaims: the theorem does not cover stochastic experiment kernels in this static lattice layer
the result is not evidence for simulation

claims.title: Fixed-benchmark deterministic and public-mixed coding gaps are monotone under observation-partition refinement
claims.scope: finite deterministic experiment subsets evaluated against one model-informed source-coding oracle vector
assumptions: a richer experiment subset refines rather than coarsens model observation cells
the controller chooses its code after learning the observation cell
public mixing uses the same independent seed resource at every subset
nonclaims: monotonicity alone does not imply submodularity
public mixing is an explicit assistance resource

claims.title: The Boolean-lattice Möbius transform gives an exact interaction decomposition of experiment-subset value
claims.scope: any rational value function defined on all subsets of a finite experiment set
assumptions: subset values are indexed by bit masks
interaction coefficients use the standard Boolean subset-lattice incidence algebra
nonclaims: Möbius coefficients are operational algebraic interactions rather than physical energies
coefficient signs are not universally constrained

claims.title: k-bit parity source coding has pure top-order deterministic experiment interaction on complete K3
claims.scope: models indexed by all k-bit strings, one deterministic experiment per bit, K3 source law equal to the parity bit, and fixed model-informed oracle coding value one
assumptions: every strict experiment subset omits at least one parity bit
complete binary zero-error K3 codebooks remain required
all k bit experiments together determine parity
nonclaims: the theorem concerns the declared K3 coding objective
it does not assert the same interaction magnitude for arbitrary Boolean functions

claims.title: k-bit parity retains pure top-order experiment interaction after independent public-seed convexification
claims.scope: the same k-bit parity/K3 family after exact public mixing of deterministic zero-error codebooks within each observation cell
assumptions: the public seed is independent of the fixed model
every strict subset leaves both parity source symbols possible
the exact finite zero-sum game is solved for each observation cell
nonclaims: public-seed convexification is an explicit assistance resource
the one-half coefficient is specific to complete binary prefix coding on K3

claims.title: Three-bit parity has zero first- and second-order nonconstant interactions and deterministic third-order coefficient minus one
claims.scope: the exact k=3 parity observation lattice
assumptions: all seven strict subsets have deterministic benchmark gap one
the full subset has gap zero
nonclaims: the coefficient minus one is not a universal third-order interaction magnitude

claims.title: Three-bit parity public-mixed lattice has sole nonconstant third-order coefficient minus one-half
claims.scope: the exact k=3 parity observation lattice after public-seed convexification
assumptions: all strict-subset mixed benchmark gaps equal one-half
the full-subset mixed gap is zero
nonclaims: the coefficient is specific to the declared finite K3 coding family

claims.title: Bounded exact observation-lattice and Möbius audit
claims.scope: Boolean Möbius/zeta inversion plus exact k=2,3,4 parity deterministic and public-mixed interaction checks
assumptions: all code enumerations, observation-cell games, experiment subsets, and game support searches complete below configured caps
all probabilities use exact rational arithmetic
nonclaims: bounded finite checks are not a scalability theorem
CI success is not empirical evidence for simulation
